blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench , comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera’s field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate , adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.
blocks.zh: 可编程世界模型将可执行动态与视觉生成分离,为下一代游戏引擎提供了一个有希望的基础. 然而,它们视而不见地遵守明确的规则和相互作用的情况仍然没有得到充分的评价。 现有基准评估视觉质量、可控性、以及指导或实际遵守情况,但很少测试是否忠实于精细、具体程序的世界事件。 我们介绍PROWBench, 包括170个节目制作的节目和600个代理视频, PROWBench 记录实体状态和时间戳事件,包括那些在相机视野之外的事件,作为可重播的世界记录,从中可以同步视图和代理表达. 这使得生成的视频能够对照程序执行的可观察到的后果被检查. 一个可扩展的框架构造了场景,控制了行为,并且可以在粗细的3D等不同的表达式和边框中使每个相机视图被渲染出. 基准覆盖了第一人称和第三人称视角,同时为一集子集提供同步多视图观测. 基于这些记录,PROWBench评价了实体控制,长视距内存,以及两个基于VLM的度量衡,即逻辑-渲染调节和相互作用成功率,遵守规定的时间线,以及可视化实现被时间标记的引擎所记录的事件.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in video world models have enabled increasingly realistic, open-ended interactive environments. However, maintaining persistent world states and enforcing user-defined rules remain challenging when entities, attributes, and interaction outcomes are represented implicitly through visual histories or latent context. Programmable World Model and Code World Model address these limitations by separating world-state evolution from visual generation ( Huang et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026b ) : coding agents and executable programs maintain states and interaction rules, while video models generate observations conditioned on structured representations of the world. This separation combines explicit state control with visual generation, but correct program execution does not guarantee faithful visual realization. A generated video may appear plausible while violating a rule or failing to depict a specified interaction. This raises a central evaluation question: can video models faithfully render the scene structure, rules, and interactions of a programmable world?
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型的最新进展使得互动环境越来越现实、开放。 然而,当实体、属性和互动结果通过视觉历史或潜在背景间接地得到体现时,维持持续的世界状态并强制执行用户定义的规则仍然具有挑战性。 可编程的世界模型和守则世界模型通过将世界状态演变与视觉生成区分开来解决这些局限性(Huang等,2026a; Chen et al., 2026b ):编码代理和可执行程序维持状态和交互规则,而视频模型生成的观测以结构化的表达世界为条件. 这种分离结合了明显的状态控制与视觉生成,但正确的程序执行并不能保证忠实的视觉实现. 生成的视频在违反规则或未能描绘特定互动时可能显得可信。 这引起了一个中心评价问题:视频模型能否忠实地实现一个可编程世界的场景结构,规则,互动?

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate video quality ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , controllability and dynamics ( Duan et al., 2025 ) , instruction following and physical adherence ( Li et al., 2025a ) , and interactive control and consistency ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Shang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Ying et al., 2026 ) . However, as summarized in Table 6.1 , they rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events: without replayable records of entity states and timestamped events, a generated video can be judged for plausibility but not against what the program executed. None of them renders the same recorded scene in paired proxy representations, and synchronized views are rare, although both are needed to isolate the effects of representation and viewpoint while holding scene content and actions fixed.
blocks.zh: 现有基准评价视频质量(黄来等,2024年),可控性和动态(杜安等,2025年),指令跟随和物理遵守(李来等,2025a),互动控制和一致性(叶来等,2026年;相克等,2026年;吴来等,2026年;徐来等,2026年;相克等,2026年). 然而,如表6.1所总结,他们很少测试忠于精细的,程序指定的世界事件:没有实体状态的可重播记录和时间戳事件,生成的视频可以被评为可信,但不能与程序执行的内容相对抗. 其中没有一个在配对代理表达中做出相同的被记录的场景,同步视图是罕见的,不过两者都需要在持有场景内容和动作固定的同时隔离表现和观点的效果.

blocks.en: To address these gaps, we introduce PROWBench , a benchmark for evaluating the visual realization of programmable worlds. PROWBench combines a programmatically constructed dataset with complementary metrics for logic adherence and interaction realization. The data engine is available for extension. It logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera’s field of view, as replayable world records and renders them into synchronized views and proxy representations, so that generated videos can be checked against the observable consequences of program execution.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了PROWBennch,这是评价可编程世界可视化实现情况的基准. PROWBench将方案构建的数据集与逻辑坚持和互动实现的补充度量衡结合起来. 数据引擎可供扩展. 它记录实体状态和时间戳事件,包括那些在相机视野之外的事件,作为可重放的世界记录,并使它们成为同步的视图和代理表达,从而可以对照程序执行的可观察到的后果来检查生成的视频.

blocks.en: PROWBench contains 170 dynamic scene episodes covering diverse environments and interactions. Each episode currently provides three synchronized representations (coarse 3D, semantic proxy, and colored oriented bounding boxes) from shared state, action, and interaction records, enabling controlled comparisons across representations. Some episodes additionally provide synchronized multi-view observations for cross-view comparisons. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control and the long-horizon memory of entities that leave and re-enter the view, and introduces two VLM-based metrics: Logic-Render Alignment assesses adherence to the prescribed timeline, while Interaction Success Rate checks whether recorded events are visually realized at the corresponding times using engine logs as ground truth. An extensible programmatic framework separates scene construction, behavior control, state recording, and rendering, allowing researchers to expand scene layouts, actions, and representations while generating aligned observations from shared state records.
blocks.zh: PROWBench包含170个动态场景片段,涵盖不同的环境和互动. 每集目前提供从共享状态,动作,和交互记录中分出三个同步的表示(粗体3D,语义代用,和向色的边框),从而可以在表示之间进行有控制的比较. 一些事件还额外提供了同步多视图观测,用于交叉视图比较. 基于这些记录,PROWBench评价了实体控制和离开和重新进入视野的实体的长期记忆,并介绍了两个基于VLM的衡量标准: Logic-Render 校正评估遵守规定时间表的情况,而互动成功率则检查所记录的事件是否在相应的时间以引擎日志作为地面真理被视觉实现. 一个可扩展的程序框架将场景构造,行为控制,状态记录,和渲染分开,使研究人员能够扩展场景布局,动作和表现,同时从共享状态记录中生成对齐的观测.

blocks.en: We evaluate state-of-the-art models with the inputs produced by this data engine: coarse 3D, semantic-proxy, and colored-OBB renders of the recorded states, together with text prompts obtained by converting the engine’s recorded events. Our experiments assess their logic adherence and interaction realization across viewpoints and representation settings. Surprisingly, with appropriate prompts, existing general-purpose video generation models such as MiniMax-H3, without task-specific training, follow the prescribed entity trajectories and event logic well, and perform on par with camera-conditioned world models in camera following without explicit camera injection. Additional task- or domain-specific training can still improve several aspects, such as entity placement and the realization of domain-specific events. The proxy itself also matters: outputs sometimes follow the input geometry too closely and inherit the coarse shapes of low-poly proxies, while box proxies leave open which described appearance belongs to which entity, so designing a good proxy remains an open problem. Long-video generation remains challenging in terms of both camera following and entity persistence, while direct multi-view generation still yields unsatisfactory results.
blocks.zh: 我们用这个数据引擎所产生的投入来评价最新模型:粗细的3D、语义-代用和有色-OBB制成的被记录状态,以及通过转换引擎所记录的事件而获得的文本提示。 我们的实验评估了它们在各种观点和代表性环境中的逻辑坚持性和互动性。 出人意料的是,在适当的提示下,诸如MiniMax-H3等现有通用视频生成模型没有经过特定任务培训,便能很好地遵循规定的实体轨迹和事件逻辑,并在没有明显相机注射的情况下,与相机条件的世界模型在相机下进行等效. 额外的特定任务或域培训仍然可以改善几个方面,例如实体设置和实现特定域的活动. 代理本身也很重要:产出有时会过于紧跟输入几何,继承了低poly代理的粗糙外形;而盒子代理则留有描述外观属于哪个实体的开口,因此设计出好代理仍然是一个开口的问题. 长相机的生成在相机跟踪和实体持续方面仍然具有挑战性,而直接多相机的生成仍然产生不令人满意的结果。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • Benchmark. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 episodes and 600 synchronized proxy videos covering multiple perspectives, visual representations, and diverse interactions, with shared world-state and action records. • Metrics. We evaluate entity control and long-horizon memory against the recorded world states, and propose Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate to assess whether generated videos follow the prescribed timeline and visually realize engine-recorded interaction events. • Extensible framework. We provide a reusable programmatic generation framework that supports extensions to scene layouts, actions, and visual representations, enabling aligned multi-view and multi-representation data generation from shared state records.
blocks.zh: • 基准。 我们介绍PROWBench, 由170集和600个同步代理视频组成, 涵盖多种视角、视觉表现和多种互动, • 计量。 我们对照记录的世界国家来评估实体控制和长视距内存,并提议逻辑-渲染调节和互动成功率,以评估生成的视频是否遵循规定的时间表和视像实现引擎记录的互动事件。 • 广泛的框架。 我们提供了一个可重复使用的程序生成框架,支持扩展到场景布局、行动和可视化表现,从而能够从共享状态记录中生成一致的多视图和多代表数据。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video World Models and Programmable World States
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频世界模式和可编程世界国家

blocks.en: Video world models predict future observations from visual context and actions. Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) learns controllable environments from unlabeled videos, while GameNGen ( Valevski et al., 2025 ) enables real-time action-conditioned game generation. GameFactory ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , Matrix-Game ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Yume1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026a ) , and LingBot-World ( Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) advance generalization, interaction, and long-horizon consistency. Memory-enhanced WorldPlay ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and AlayaWorld ( Team et al., 2026 ) improve persistence through spatial-context retrieval or reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型从视觉背景和行动预测出未来的观测. Genie (Bruce等, 2024) 从无标签的视频中学习可控环境,而GameNGen (Valevski等, 2025) 则可以实现实时动作条件游戏生成. GameFactory (Yu等,2025年),Matrix-Game (张等,2025年),Yume1.5 (Mao等,2026a),和凌. Bot-World (Robbyant Team等, 2026) 推进通论,互动,并长相相统一. 记忆增强后的世界Play (Sun等, 2025年), Matrix-Game 3.0 (Wang等, 2026年),以及Alaya World (Team等, 2026年) 通过空间-context检索或重建提高持久性.

blocks.en: While these models infer states from visual history and memory, programmable world models externalize state evolution. Code World Model ( Chen et al., 2026b ) uses a coding agent to maintain executable states and interaction logic, while Programmable World Model ( Huang et al., 2026a ) feeds persistent structured states to a generative renderer. Other approaches similarly separate state or dynamics from appearance ( Meng et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Cai et al., 2026a ) . PROWBench evaluates whether generated observations faithfully realize these explicit states and interactions.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些模型从视觉历史和记忆中推断出来,但可编程的世界模型将状态进化外部化. Code World Model (Chen et al., 2026b.)使用编码剂来维持可执行状态和相互作用逻辑,而Programable World Model (Huang et al., 2026a.)则将持久性结构化状态反馈给基因转化器. 其他方法类似地将状态或动态与外观相分离(Meng等,2026;Lin等,2026b;Cai等,2026a.). PROWBennch评价生成的观测是否忠实地实现了这些明确状态和相互作用.

blocks.en: 2.2 Structured Representations for Visual Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉一代的结构化代表

blocks.en:
Structured conditions offer direct spatial control through depth, trajectories, bounding boxes, masks, and camera motion ( Esser et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2024d ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025c ) . Geometry-aware methods incorporate 3D boxes, bird’s-eye-view layouts, world volumes, and structured traffic scenes ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2024c ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .
Generative rendering uses explicit geometry or renderer-derived signals: Coarse-to-Real ( Gomez-Nogales et al., 2026 ) and VideoFrom3D ( Kim et al., 2025 ) use coarse 3D scenes, while Diffusion Renderer ( Liang et al., 2025 ) , AlayaRenderer ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , its real-time extension ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , and LiVER ( Cai et al., 2026b ) use denser rendering cues. These approaches span sparse object controls to dense geometric representations.
Comparisons across representations are often confounded by differences in models, datasets, and tasks. PROWBench derives paired proxy representations from the same recorded world-state trajectory and camera configuration, isolating representation effects on visual realization under fixed scene evolution.
blocks.zh:
结构化的条件通过深度、轨迹、边框、口罩和相机运动提供直接空间控制(Esser等,2023;Wang等,2024a;Li等,2025b;Wang等,2024d;Luo等,2025;Jain等,2024;Li等,2025c)。 几何感知方法包括了3D盒,鸟眼观图布局,世界卷和结构化交通场景(高等等,2024;李等,2024;文等,2024;陆等,2024;王等,2024;王等,2024;王等,2024c;王等,2025).
基因渲染使用明显的几何或出自渲染器的信号: 粗到Real(Gomez-Nogales等,2026年)和VideoFrom3D(Kim等,2025年)使用粗到3D场景,而分化放送器(Liang等,2025年)则使用粗到3D场景. AlayaRenderer (Huang等, 2026b.),其实时扩展(Lin等, 2026a.),和LiVER(Cai等, 2026b.)使用更稠密的渲染提示. 这些方法跨越了稀有的物体控制到密集的几何表示.
各种表述的比较往往因模型、数据集和任务的差异而困惑。 PROWBench从相同的被记录的世界状态轨迹和相机配置中衍生出配对的代理表示,在固定的场景演化下隔离对视觉实现的表示效果.

blocks.en: 2.3 World Model Benchmarks and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3 世界示范基准和评价

blocks.en: VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and EvalCrafter ( Liu et al., 2024 ) assess video quality, temporal consistency, motion, and semantic alignment. WorldSimBench ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , WorldModelBench ( Li et al., 2025a ) , and WorldScore ( Duan et al., 2025 ) extend evaluation to physical plausibility, controllability, and world dynamics. MIND ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , WorldMark ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , Omni-WorldBench ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , WorldArena ( Shang et al., 2026 ) , and iWorld-Bench ( Fang et al., 2026 ) further target interactive behavior, memory, and long-horizon consistency.
blocks.zh: V Bench (Huang等, 2024年)和EvalCrafter (Liu等, 2024年)评估视频质量,时间一致性,运动,和语义相接. WorldSim Bench(秦等,2025年),"WorldModel Bench"(李等,2025年a),"WorldScore"(杜安等,2025年)将评价扩展到了物理的可信度,可控性和世界动态. 明德(Ye等人,2026年),世界 Mark (Xu等,2026年),Omni-World Bench (Wu等,2026年),WorldArena (Shang等,2026年),和iWorld-Bench (Fang等,2026年)进一步针对互动行为,记忆,和长视一致性.

blocks.en: WBench ( Ying et al., 2026 ) evaluates multi-turn navigation, subject actions, event editing, and perspective switching for instruction adherence, consistency, and physical plausibility. These benchmarks generally assess complete pipelines, coupling errors in action understanding, state prediction, memory, dynamics, and rendering.
blocks.zh: W Bench (Ying等,2026年)评价多回转导航,主题动作,事件编辑,以及视角切换,以达到指令的坚持性,一致性,以及物理上的合理性. 这些基准一般评估完整的管道,将动作理解、状态预测、内存、动态和渲染方面的错误相接。

blocks.en: PROWBench isolates rendering fidelity using engine-recorded frame-level states, rules, and timestamped interactions, enabling comparisons across synchronized perspectives and proxy representations under the same trajectory. Logic-Renderer Alignment measures whether specified rules are visibly realized, while Interaction measures whether recorded events appear at the corresponding times.
blocks.zh: PROWBench通过引擎录制的帧级别状态,规则,以及时间标记的相互作用来隔离表达忠贞性,从而能够在同一轨迹下对同步视角和代理表达进行比较. 逻辑-渲染器对齐度测量特定规则是否明显实现,而交互度测量记录的事件是否出现在相应的时间.

blocks.en: 3.1 World Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 世界一代人 管道

blocks.en: We introduce a pipeline for constructing programmable worlds and producing structured conditioning inputs and evaluation annotations for generative video models. The pipeline provides three complementary capabilities: world synthesis , control compilation , and final process . Together, these capabilities produce replayable world trajectories, synchronized conditioning inputs, and structured evaluation records.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一条管道,用于构建可编程世界,并为基因视频模型制作结构化的调理投入和评价说明. 管道提供三种互补能力:世界综合、控制汇编和最后过程。 这些能力共同产生可回放的世界轨迹,同步调节投入,以及结构化的评价记录.

blocks.en: World Synthesis. The pipeline constructs dynamic worlds from configurations specifying the environment, entity layout, participating actors, task controllers, random seeds, and execution duration. Procedural routines generate terrain, buildings, roads, interiors, and interaction objects, together with collision surfaces, collision constraints, and interaction anchors. Entities have persistent episode-level identifiers, semantic categories, component hierarchies, and task-relevant attributes. Random seeds control variations in scene layouts, motion paths, speeds, and animation phases.
blocks.zh: 世界综合. 管道从指定环境、实体布局、参与行为者、任务控制器、随机种子和执行期限的配置中构建动态世界。 程序常规产生地形,建筑物,道路,内部,和相互作用物体,再加上相撞表面,相撞约束,以及相互作用锚. 各实体具有持续的事件级识别特征、语义分类、组件等级以及与任务有关的属性。 随机种子控制在场景布局,运动路径,速度,和动画阶段的变化.

blocks.en: Specialized controllers coordinate articulated poses, object trajectories, and participant interactions through procedural animation and motion models. They support three broad categories of behavior. Interaction controllers organize tasks into explicit phases: for example, carrying proceeds through approaching, grasping, lifting, transporting, and releasing an object, with corresponding updates to hand targets and object ownership. Activity and locomotion controllers support animal behaviors and simplified flight and swimming dynamics. Driving controllers provide closed-loop control of vehicle motion. During execution, these controllers report action phases, participating entities, and relationship changes for recording and validation. External agents can query entities, submit supported actions or plans, advance the world by fixed ticks, and inspect execution feedback.
blocks.zh: 专门的控制器通过程序动画和运动模型来协调所表现的姿势,物体轨迹,以及参与者的相互作用. 他们支持三大类的行为. 交互控制器将任务组织成明确的阶段:例如,通过接近,抓取,起重,运输和放出一个对象来携带收益,并附有相应的更新来手取目标和对象所有权. 活动和运动控制器支持动物行为并简化出行和游泳动态. 驾驶控制器对车辆运动进行闭路控制。 在执行期间,这些控制员报告行动阶段、参与实体以及用于记录和验证的关系变化。 外部代理商可以查询实体,提交支持的行动或计划,用固定的勾子推进世界,并检查执行反馈.

blocks.en: Each execution produces a structured episode record containing shared scene geometry, entity definitions and hierarchies, initial conditions, and temporal records of entity transforms, articulated poses, visibility, and appearance changes. Controller events and available input traces accompany these records, with explicit temporal mappings linking world execution, saved states, and video frames. Each saved state can be reconstructed independently from the shared scene description and its corresponding dynamic record. Configurations, random seeds, and source information are retained for provenance tracking.
blocks.zh: 每一次执行都会产生一个结构化的插曲记录,包含共享场景几何,实体定义和分级,初始条件,以及实体变换的时间记录,清晰的姿势,能见度,外观变化等. 控制器事件和现有输入痕迹与这些记录相伴随,并有明确的时间映射,将世界执行、保存状态和视频帧联系起来。 每个被保存状态可以独立于共享场景描述及其相应的动态记录进行重建. 配置、随机种子和源信息被保留用于来源跟踪。

blocks.en: Control Compilation. The pipeline compiles recorded world states and camera trajectories into synchronized visual conditioning inputs for generative video models.
blocks.zh: 控制编译. 管道将录入的世界状态和相机轨迹编译为基因视频模型的同步视觉调节输入.

blocks.en: Third-person cameras follow task-dependent trajectories, while first-person cameras are derived from recorded head positions, character or vehicle orientations, and task-specific gaze information. The observing character’s display geometry is hidden in its first-person view, while its entity and articulated state remain in the shared world record. Final camera trajectories include intrinsics, camera-to-world and world-to-camera matrices, projection parameters, and clipping planes. Additional cameras can be associated with different participants to provide multiple perspectives of the same episode.
blocks.zh: 第三人称相机遵循任务所依赖的轨迹,而第一人称相机则取自所记录的头部位置,人物或车辆取向,以及任务所特有的凝视信息. 观测人物的显示几何学隐藏在其第一人称视图中,而其实体和所表述的状态则仍保留在共享的世界记录中. 最终相机轨迹包括内在,相机对世界和相机对世界的矩阵,投影参数和剪接平面. 额外的相机可以和不同的参与者相接,以提供同一集的多视角.

blocks.en: Rendering adapters map shared world records to conditioning representations. Our current implementation provides three representations. Coarse 3D representation (Coarse 3D) uses neutral materials to preserve scene shape, object silhouettes, and articulated motion. Semantic proxy (CWM proxy) combines semantically colored environments with simplified entity proxies, retaining global trajectories, orientations, and task-relevant posture while reducing local articulation and shape detail. Colored oriented bounding boxes (Colored-OBB) represent selected entities through spatial envelopes, stable instance colors, and directional cues, with a semi-transparent white face marking the front of each entity, while retaining geometry for environmental structures and simple objects. OBB bounds are updated over time, while instance colors remain consistent across frames and views.
blocks.zh: 渲染适配器映射共享世界纪录 以调节表示. 我们目前的执行情况提供了三项陈述。 粗口3D代表(Coarse 3D)使用中性材料来保存场景外形,物体的分光,并有清晰的动作. 语义代用(CWM 代理)将分色环境与简化实体代用结合,保留了全局的轨迹,取向,和与任务相关的姿态,同时减少局部的表达和形状细节. 向色边框(Cororred-OBB)通过空间信封,稳定的实例颜色和方向提示来代表被选中的实体,每个实体的正面都标有半透明的白色面相,同时保留环境结构和简单对象的几何. OBB界限随时间推移而更新,而实例颜色在框架和视图之间仍然一致。

blocks.en: Final Process. The pipeline exports three categories of outputs: scene and motion records, rendered observations, and text and interaction labels. Scene and motion records support replay and include scene geometry, entity identities and semantic categories, spatial and articulated states, joint poses, bounding volumes, and entity and camera trajectories with associated camera parameters. Rendered observations comprise synchronized proxy videos across viewpoints and representations, accompanied by metric depth interpreted with respect to its recorded geometry. Text and interaction labels describe action phases, participant relationships, and timestamped events, together with accompanying textual descriptions and contact targets and residuals.
blocks.zh: 最后进程。 管道输出三类产出:场景和运动记录、观察、文字和互动标签。 场景和运动记录支持重放,并包括场景几何,实体身份和语义类别,空间和表达状态,联合姿势,受限量,以及实体和相机轨迹等相关相机参数. 制作的观察包括各种观点和表述的同步代理视频,并附有对其所记录几何特征的度量深度解释。 文字和交互标签描述动作阶段,参与者关系,和被打出时间戳的事件,以及随附的文字描述和接触目标及剩余.

blocks.en: Validation comprises four complementary components. Task and timeline checks assess scenario-specific phases, terminal conditions or state validity, and recording coverage. They also verify task-level interaction labels against the applicable annotation policy and required participant categories. Geometric checks evaluate penetration, support, and contact consistency at saved states using canonical geometry. Replay and alignment checks assess state reconstruction, camera alignment, and consistency with the selected representation. They further establish correspondence among videos, depth, and state labels using source records, frame indices, camera information, and timestamps. Visual and media quality checks combine first-frame visibility measurements based on canonical-geometry pixel counts and view-frustum tests with documented visual inspection of first frames and selected temporal samples. These inspections assess subject visibility and observation readability, while media decoding and hash checks assess output integrity. Visibility measurements and visual reviews are interpreted within the scope of the recorded frames and geometry.
blocks.zh: 鉴定由四个相辅相成的组成部分组成。 任务和时间表检查评估特定情景阶段、终端条件或状态有效性以及记录覆盖范围。 他们还对照适用的注释政策和要求的参与者类别,核查任务层面的互动标签。 几何检查使用犬形几何来评价在被保存状态下的穿透度,支持和接触一致性. 重放和校正检查评估状态重建,相机校正,以及与所选代表的一致性. 他们利用源头记录、帧指数、相机信息和时间戳进一步建立视频、深度和状态标签之间的对应关系。 视觉和介质质量检查将基于舟-地测量像素计数的第一帧能见度测量和取景-棱镜测试与记录的第一帧能见度检查和选定的时间样本相结合. 这些检查评估主题的能见度和观察的可读性,而媒体解码和散列检查评估产出的完整性。 可见度测量和视觉评论在所记录的框架和几何学范围内进行解释.

blocks.en: To preserve provenance and revision history, failed attempts and their available diagnostics are retained separately from accepted episodes. For each batch-specific revision, affected outputs are backed up, changes to world records, camera trajectories, or representation policies are documented, and the corresponding media and metadata are updated together. Hash checks verify the integrity of unchanged source records where applicable. Sample metadata and source hashes link released observations to their source records, rendering configurations, and verification reports.
blocks.zh: 为了保存出处和修正历史,失败的尝试及其可用的诊断与公认的事件分开保留. 每批特定修改时,都会对受影响的产出进行备份,对世界记录,相机轨迹,或表现政策的修改进行记录,并同时更新相应的介质和元数据. 在适用的情况下,哈斯检查核实未变源记录的完整性。 元数据样本和源散列将所发布的观察与其源记录,渲染配置以及核查报告相链接.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Suite
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价套件

blocks.en: We evaluate five complementary capabilities: controllability, visual and temporal quality, logic and state alignment, multi-view consistency, and long-horizon memory. Engine-recorded trajectories, events, and states provide references for evaluating adherence to the prescribed world evolution, while established perceptual metrics assess video quality.
blocks.zh: 我们评价五个互补能力:可控性、视觉和时间质量、逻辑和状态一致、多视图一致性和长视距记忆。 引擎所录入的轨迹,事件,和状态为评价遵守规定的世界进化过程提供了参考,而既定的知觉度量评估视频质量.

blocks.en: Controllability. We evaluate whether entities and the camera follow their prescribed trajectories. For entity control, we consider dynamic and interaction-relevant entities visible in the reference view, excluding terrain, effects, and scene geometry. Generated entities are localized with SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) from semantic-label prompts and matched to engine-projected references by label-compatible Hungarian matching. BBox IoU measures spatial alignment over the visible trajectory, with missed detections assigned zero IoU, while Center Error measures normalized center displacement conditional on detection. We report clip-level averages over evaluable entities; full visibility, matching, and aggregation details are provided in Appendix 7 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Tracks
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准轨迹

blocks.en: PROWBench organizes its evaluation cases into two tracks with four settings. Each setting uses its own evaluation set, and the scenes of the two main-track settings are disjoint.
blocks.zh: PROWBENCH将其评价案例分为两个轨道,设置有四个. 每个设置都使用自己的评价集,两个主道设置的场景是脱节的.

blocks.en: Main Track. The main track evaluates controlled generation of five-second clips in two settings that differ in the appearance reference and use disjoint scenes. When the agent already has an appearance reference, such as a concept image or a prescribed character design, it can supply it as the RGB first frame. The Verified-FF setting evaluates this case with 40 scene-camera pairs (31 third-person follow, 9 first-person; top of Table 1 ). Its RGB first frame is part of the benchmark: it is generated with MiniMax-H3 from the colored-OBB proxy and the scene description and checked against the recorded person count, positions, facing and layout (Appendix 6.2 ), and every method that accepts a first frame receives this identical image. In procedural game-world construction, the agent usually has no ready-made RGB appearance reference. The Unverified-FF setting therefore prescribes only the world state, the text, and the control signals, and asks whether models can jointly solve entity control, appearance generation, and identity binding. It contains 90 pairs (78 third-person follow, 12 first-person; bottom of Table 1 ), and appearance must be determined by each model from the text and the control signal. The curation of this set used MiniMax-H3 outputs, so results involving MiniMax-H3 should be read with this potential bias in mind.
blocks.zh: 主轨. 主音轨评价在外观参考不同且使用脱节场景的两种场合下,可控生成5秒片段. 当代理已经有一个外观参考,例如概念图像或规定的角色设计时,它可以作为RGB的第一帧提供. 经验证的-FF设定以40个场景相机配对(31个第三人接后,9个第一人称;表1上方)来评价这个案例. 其RGB第一帧是基准的一部分:它由有色-OBB代理和场景描述产生的MiniMax-H3并对照所记录的人物计数,位置,面相和布局(Appendix 6.2)来检查,接受第一帧的每一种方法都会得到这个相同的图像. 在程序游戏-世界构造中,代理通常没有现成的RGB外观参考. 因此,Unevilized-FF设置只规定了世界状态,文本,以及控制信号,并询问模型是否能够共同解决实体控制,外观生成,以及身份约束. 它包含90对(78个第三人称跟随,12个第一人称;表1下方),外观必须由从文本和控制信号的每个模型决定. 本集的校正使用了MiniMax-H3输出,因此,在阅读涉及MiniMax-H3的结果时,应铭记这种潜在的偏差.

blocks.en: Challenge Track. The challenge track tests whether short-clip control extends to two harder settings. Control in short clips does not guarantee that a model maintains one world state over longer horizons, in which entities leave the view, re-enter later and keep their state and motion across generation windows. The long-horizon setting (Table 2 ) contains ten 30-second recordings, one camera each. In a multi-player game, each player observes the same world through their own camera. Even when each view is generated independently, the views must agree on where each participant is, who they are, what they look like, and the scene structure. The multi-view setting (Table 3 ) contains ten four-player scenes, each with four synchronized third-person follow views, one per player, generated independently.
blocks.zh: 挑战赛道. 挑战道测试短剪控制是否延伸到两个更难的设置. 短片中的控制并不能保证一个模型在更长的视野内维持一个世界状态,其中实体离开视野,稍后再进入,并保持其状态和跨生成窗口的运动. 长视距设定(表2)包含10个30秒的录音,每个相机1个. 在多人游戏中,每个玩家通过自己的相机观察同一个世界. 即使每种观点都是独立生成的,观点也必须就每个参与者的位置,身份,相貌,场景结构达成一致. 多取景设定(表3)包含10个4个玩家场景,每个场景有4个同步的第三人称跟随取景,每个玩家一个,独立生成.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments address a central question: can current video generation and video world models faithfully render a prescribed dynamic world, rather than merely produce visually plausible videos? For game worlds, visual quality alone is insufficient. A successful model must follow prescribed entity trajectories, camera motion, and event timelines, while maintaining consistency over long horizons and across synchronized views. We therefore organize the evaluation into a main track of five-second clips and a challenge track of long-horizon and multi-view settings. Sections 4.3 and 4.4 report the results, and Section 4.5 compares the method classes across both tracks and draws the main takeaways. The experimental setup is detailed in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涉及一个中心问题:目前的视频生成和视频世界模型能否忠实地实现一个规定的动态世界,而不是仅仅产生视觉上可信的视频? 对于游戏世界,光是视觉质量是不够的. 一个成功的模型必须遵循规定的实体轨迹、相机运动和事件时间表,同时在长视野和同步视图中保持一致性。 因此,我们把评价组织成由五秒钟短片组成的主要轨道,以及长视和多视环境的挑战轨道。 第4.3和4.4节报告了结果,第4.5节比较了两条轨道上的方法类别并抽取了主要外卖。 实验设置详见第4.2节.

blocks.en: All evaluation samples come from recorded game-world states and are scored against the engine state; each sample is one scene observed by one camera. Every recorded state is provided in three proxy representations, Coarse 3D, CWM proxy and Colored-OBB, together with engine depth, the camera trajectory, a scene description and the state of every object, and each method receives the control representation of its native interface. Text prompts are generated automatically from the recorded scene, entities, and action timeline. All models are evaluated in their native output formats against the same engine records; the engine renders of the proxies are scored as diagnostic references. The tracks and settings are defined in Section 3.3 . Methods whose native interface requires an RGB image (the world models and CWM) receive frame 0 of the MiniMax-H3 output for the same scene and camera; this frame is not a prescribed reference, but it can transmit MiniMax-H3’s appearance assignments, and analyses of appearance identity account separately for effects inherited from it.

blocks.en: 4.5 Discussion and Takeaways
blocks.zh: 4.5 讨论和带走

blocks.en:
We now compare the three method classes of Section 4.1 : camera-conditioned world models, task-specific renderers that translate a proxy into RGB video (Cosmos-Transfer2.5, C2R, CWM, LynnReal-Omni and, on the gunfight set, PWM), and general-purpose video foundation models that receive the proxy video as a reference (MiniMax-H3, Seedance 2.5). Figure 3 summarizes the Main-track results by class; unless stated otherwise, comparisons are paired over scenes with a sign test.
Method rankings are closely across the Verified-FF and Unverified-FF settings. The Spearman rank correlations between the per-method means in the two parts of Table 1 are 0.98 0.98 for BBox IoU, 0.93 0.93 for translation error, 0.95 0.95 for CamMC, and 0.91 0.91 for Logic-Render Alignment. We organize the following discussion around seven takeaways.

blocks.zh: T1 来自代理机的渲染在跟随实体轨迹和事件时间表时会击败相机调制.

blocks.en: Both proxy-conditioned classes place entities far better than the camera-conditioned world model: the class-mean BBox IoU is higher in 38 of 40 Verified-FF scenes and 87 of 89 Unverified-FF scenes (median + 0.14 +0.14 , p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ), with class means of 0.450 0.450 (task-specific) and 0.465 0.465 (general-purpose) against 0.322 0.322 in Verified-FF, and 0.376 0.376 and 0.373 0.373 against 0.235 0.235 in Unverified-FF. In Figure 8.3 , the proxy-conditioned models keep both cars in their reference boxes while one of them passes the walking protagonist (per-entity IoU 0.62 0.62 – 0.86 0.86 ); EchoWM keeps the protagonist ( 0.63 0.63 ) but does not bring the oncoming car past the protagonist and lets the car ahead fall back toward the camera instead of keeping its distance ( 0.27 0.27 and 0.29 0.29 ). Camera-conditioned world models do control entities implicitly, through the text prompt, the first frame and, for the protagonist, a follow camera that keeps it in view. This implicit control places the protagonist about as well as the proxy (protagonist BBox IoU 0.44 0.44 and 0.42 0.42 against 0.46 0.46 – 0.54 0.54 for the proxy-conditioned classes, over third-person views) but not the other entities ( 0.26 0.26 and 0.20 0.20 against 0.38 0.38 – 0.44 0.44 ). Events follow the same pattern when the proxy is paired with a strong video prior. Interaction Success checks whether each engine-recorded event reaches both its prescribed action and end state, and Logic-Render Alignment whether each segment of the prescribed timeline is visibly depicted (Figure 8.4 ).  General-purpose models exceed the camera-conditioned world models in Logic-Render Alignment in both settings (26 of 32 and 57 of 77 non-tied scenes, p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ) and in Interaction Success in Unverified-FF (42 of 61, p = 0.004 p=0.004 ), and the renderers fine-tuned from MiniMax-H3 are also strong (LynnReal-Omni has the highest Logic-Render Alignment in both settings). The task-specific class as a whole, however, is not better than the camera-conditioned world models (Interaction Success in 15 of 27 and 29 of 66 scenes), because Cosmos-Transfer2.5 has the lowest Interaction Success and Logic-Render Alignment in both settings. LingBot achieves the highest Interaction Success in Verified-FF, but correct actions and end states do not guarantee correct interaction locations, so this result should be interpreted alongside entity control results.

blocks.en: The proxy video is rendered from the prescribed camera, so it carries the camera motion implicitly. General-purpose models, which receive no camera trajectory, tie with EchoWM, SANA-WM and LingBot 2.0 in CamMC: the class mean is lower in 20 of 40 Verified-FF and 45 of 90 Unverified-FF scenes ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 ). Per sample, MiniMax-H3 does not differ significantly from EchoWM, SANA-WM and LingBot 2.0 in CamMC in Verified-FF (sign test, p > 0.2 p>0.2 ) and has a lower translation error than EchoWM and SANA-WM in 74% of the Unverified-FF pairs ( p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ), whereas LingBot 2.0 has lower camera errors than Seedance 2.5 in most pairs of both settings. MiniMax-H3, Seedance 2.5 and LynnReal-Omni all outperform AlayaWorld v1.1 in 87–98% of the pairs in translation error and CamMC. Figure 5 compares each sample with LingBot 2.0, the camera-conditioned model with the lowest CamMC in Unverified-FF: MiniMax-H3 has the lower camera error in 52% of the samples, Seedance 2.5 in 36%, and LynnReal-Omni in 78%.

blocks.en: The composition of the proxy also matters for camera control. Figure 5 examines how proxy components affect camera control across 20 scene-camera pairs. Starting from entity boxes, adding ground reduces CamMC from 0.243 0.243 to 0.213 0.213 , while adding sky provides no further improvement ( 0.223 0.223 ). Incorporating 50% of the background objects produces larger gains, reducing rotation error from 6.89 ∘ 6.89^{\circ} to 3.31 ∘ 3.31^{\circ} , translation error from 0.135 0.135 to 0.105 0.105 , and CamMC from 0.243 0.243 to 0.147 0.147 relative to boxes-only proxies. The illustrated scene exhibits the same pattern: mean rotation error remains near 16 ∘ 16^{\circ} after adding ground and sky, but falls to 4.89 ∘ 4.89^{\circ} when background objects are included. These results suggest that explicit background structure supplies useful spatial cues for reproducing prescribed camera motion. The full-background reference achieves still lower errors, with a rotation error of 1.91 ∘ 1.91^{\circ} and CamMC of 0.109 0.109 . However, this setting also differs in prompts, first-frame inputs, and some entity-box sets, so its additional gains cannot be attributed solely to increased background coverage.

blocks.en: T3 General-purpose video generation models already render short clips well.
blocks.zh: T3 通用视频生成模型已经使短片剪辑效果良好。

blocks.en: On the short, single-camera clips of the main track, general-purpose models are competitive with task-specific renderers across several metrics. They achieve comparable BBox IoU (23 of 40 and 43 of 89 scenes), lower camera errors (CamMC in 30 of 40 and 76 of 90 scenes, p ≤ 0.003 p\leq 0.003 ), and higher Interaction Success and Logic-Render Alignment in Unverified-FF (53 of 67 and 61 of 79 scenes, p ≈ 10 − 6 p\approx 10^{-6} ). They also achieve the lowest warping error, with class means of 0.38 0.38 and 0.33 0.33 , compared with 0.72 0.72 and 0.83 0.83 for task-specific renderers.
blocks.zh: 在主轨短短的单相机片段上,通用型号在多个度量衡上与特定任务渲染器具有竞争力. 它们实现了类似的BBox IoU(89场景中的23起和43起),下相机出错(40场景中的30起和90场景中的76起相机出错,第0.003页,第0.003页),以及在未核实的FF中实现更高的互动成功和逻辑-渲染对接(79场景中的67起和61起相机出错,第10-6起相机出错,第10-6起相机出错,第10-6起相机出错)。 它们也实现了最低的曲折误差,分级手段为0.38 0.38和0.33 0.33.,而任务特定渲染器则达到0.72 0.72和0.83 0.83.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning does not, however, yield uniform improvements. CWM and LynnReal-Omni both build on MiniMax-H3, enabling paired comparisons with their general-purpose base. CWM has lower BBox IoU in 71% of the Unverified-FF pairs ( p = 10 − 4 p=10^{-4} ) and lower imaging quality in approximately 90% of the pairs in both settings, but lower warping error in approximately 80%. LynnReal-Omni achieves higher BBox IoU in 62% of the Unverified-FF pairs ( p = 0.03 p=0.03 ) and higher Logic-Render Alignment in 81% of the non-tied Verified-FF pairs ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ), but higher warping error in every pair in both settings. Because lower warping error can also reflect reduced motion, it should not be interpreted as an unqualified improvement in temporal consistency. These comparisons show that the benefits of fine-tuning depend on the model and the control objective.
blocks.zh: 然而,微调并不产生统一的改进。 CWM和LynnReal-Omni都以MiniMax-H3为基础,能够与它们的普通用途基础进行对等比较。 CWM在71%的未验证-FF对(p = 10– 4 p = 10^{-4})中拥有较低的BBox IoU,在两种设置中,约90%的对相成像质量较低,但约80%的对相成像出错较少. LynnReal-Omni在62%的未验证-FF配对(p = 0.03 p = 0.03)中实现了更高的BBox IoU,在81%的非已验证-FF配对(p = 0.02 p = 0.02)中实现了更高的逻辑-渲染对等,但两种设置中每对配对都出现了更高的扭曲出错. 由于更低的曲折误差也能够反映运动的减少,因此不应被解释为时间一致性的无条件改进. 这些比较表明,微调的好处取决于模型和控制目标.

blocks.en: Despite their strong performance on short clips, general-purpose models can still struggle to execute prescribed events reliably. We illustrate this limitation on a dedicated evaluation set of 20 gunfight scenes in which one person is shot and collapses according to a prescribed schedule (Table 4 ). We compare the general-purpose pipelines with PWM, a domain-specific model trained on a limited set of scenes. The first frames are generated by MiniMax-H3 ( MiniMax-AI, 2026 ) . MiniMax-H3 achieves a BBox IoU of 0.526 0.526 and an Interaction Success Rate of 0.600 0.600 , while PWM reaches 0.602 0.602 and 0.850 0.850 , respectively. The gap in Interaction Success Rate highlights a limitation of general-purpose rendering: reasonable spatial alignment does not guarantee reliable execution of a prescribed event. Furthermore, as shown in Figure 6 , outputs from general-purpose models sometimes exhibit proxy leakage, whereas such artifacts are rarely observed in PWM’s outputs.
blocks.zh: 尽管通用模型在短片上的性能很强,但仍可能难以可靠地执行规定的事件. 我们用20个枪战场景的一套专门评价来说明这一限制,其中一人被击中并被按规定的时间表击倒(表4)。 我们把通用管线与PWM进行比较,PWM是一个针对特定域的模型,在有限的一组场景上接受培训. 第一个帧由MiniMax-H3(MiniMax-AI,2026)生成. MiniMax-H3实现Box IoU为0.526 0.526,互动成功率为0.600 0.600;而PWM则分别达到0.602 0.602和0.850 0.850. 互动成功率的差距凸显出通用渲染的局限性:合理的空间相接不能保证一个指定事件的可靠执行. 此外,如图6所显示的,通用模型的产出有时会出现代理渗出,而这种文物很少在PWM的产出中被观察到。

blocks.en: T5 The next step is finding the best proxy.
blocks.zh: T5型导弹 下一步是找到最好的代理

blocks.en:
The proxy decides what the renderer is told, but its form matters little for placement. Table 5 compares three proxies on ten Verified-FF pairs (nine follow, one first-person): the coarse-3D-proxy, CWM-proxy and colored-BBox rows are generated with the same first frames, seed and generation settings. All metrics follow the protocol of Table 1 but cover only this subset. The layout barely changes with the proxy (BBox IoU 0.503 0.503 – 0.514 0.514 ), and camera and quality metrics differ little. The event metrics differ more, but only through a few scenes: the colored-OBB proxy has the highest Interaction Success ( 0.733 0.733 against 0.625 0.625 – 0.683 0.683 ; higher than the coarse 3D proxy in three scenes and lower in none, and higher than the CWM proxy in two scenes and lower in one), and the coarse 3D proxy has the highest Logic–Render Alignment ( 0.802 0.802 ; higher than the colored-OBB proxy in four scenes and lower in one); with ten pairs, none of these differences is significant (sign test, p ≥ 0.25 p\geq 0.25 ).
From our visualizations, we observe that, compared with coarse 3D and CWM proxies, colored-OBB proxies generate more natural human motions, with richer joint articulation and more refined strides. Therefore, we use the colored-OBB proxy as the representation input to Minimax-H3 in our evaluation.
blocks.zh:
代理决定制作者被告知什么,但其形式对放置不重要. 表5比较了十个验证-FF对上的3个代名词(9个接后,1个第一人称):粗-3D-代名词,CWM-代名词和有色-BBox等行由相同的第一帧,种子和生成设置所生成. 所有度量衡都遵循了表1的协议,但只涵盖这个子集. 其布局随代用(BBox IoU 0.503 0.503 – 0.514 0.514)而变化不大,相机和质量度量衡也相差不大. 事件指标差异较大,但仅通过几个场景:有色-OBB代理成功率最高(0.733 0.733对0.625 0.625 – 0.683 0.683;在三个场景中高于粗细的3D代理,在无色下;在两个场景中高于CWM代理,在一场更低),而粗细的3D代理则具有最高的逻辑-Render对接(0.802 0.802;在四个场景中高于多彩-OB代理,在一场更低);有十对,这些差异无一显著(签名测试,p-0.25 p\geq 0.25).
从我们的可视化来看,我们观察到,相较于粗糙的3D和CWM代位,有色-OBB代位产生更多的自然人类运动,更丰富的联合表达和更精细的进取. 因此,我们使用彩色-OBB代理作为评价中Minimax-H3的表示输入.

blocks.en: However, the proxy leaves a key ambiguity unresolved: which appearance belongs to which entity. A box proxy fixes where each entity is and how it moves, but not what it looks like; which described appearance belongs to which box must be inferred from the text. Without a visual reference, the model must infer from text which appearance description belongs to which person. As a result, even when the overall scene and actions appear plausible, identity–appearance associations can be incorrect. In the supermarket example in Figure 8.10 a (Appendix 8.2 ), which contains a courier, a student, and a tourist, MiniMax-H3 swaps the student’s and tourist’s outfits throughout the clip. Seedance 2.5 assigns the courier’s outfit to the student’s position while leaving the courier’s box empty, whereas LynnReal-Omni preserves the intended appearance assignment for all three characters. In a manual audit of 62 multi-person scenes, MiniMax-H3 swaps the appearances of two people in 12 cases. These examples suggest that visually plausible multi-person generation can still exhibit errors in maintaining entity identity and associated appearance attributes.
blocks.zh: 然而,代理机留下了关键模糊性未解决:哪个外观属于哪个实体. 框代理定义每个实体的位置和移动方式,而不是其外观;描述的外观属于哪个框必须从文本中推断出. 没有视觉参考,模型必须从哪个外观描述属于哪个人的文本中推断出. 因此,即使整个场景和行动看起来是可信的,身份-出现协会也可能是不正确的。 在图8.10 a(附录8.2)的超市中, 包括一名信使、一名学生和一名游客, 种子2.5将信使的服装分配到学生的位置,而信使的盒子却空出一空,而Lynn Real-Omni则保留了所有三个角色的预定外观任务. 在对62个多人场景的人工审计中,MiniMax-H3在12个案件中互换了两人相貌. 这些例子表明,视似可信的多人一代在保持实体身份和相关外观属性方面仍然可能出现出错.

blocks.en: The same ambiguity affects orientation. Without an image that fixes how each entity looks from the camera, models sometimes render an entity facing the opposite way. In the horseback scene of Figure 8.10 b, the horse on the right faces away from the camera: LynnReal-Omni and MiniMax-H3 show its rear, whereas Seedance 2.5 renders it facing the camera. The entity is placed in its box, but its front–back direction is not controlled reliably. The mixed representation in Figure 8.5 (Appendix 8.2 ) likewise omits limbs, whereas the coarse 3D proxy keeps them. A proxy that encodes identity, facing direction and articulation while remaining cheap to render is therefore a direct lever for faithful rendering, and the benchmark can compare candidate proxies under a fixed generator as in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 同样的模糊性影响到取向。 没有图像可以固定每个实体从相机中的样子,模型有时会使一个实体面对相反的方式. 在图8.10b的骑马场景中,右侧的马从相机上向外走出:LynnReal-Omni和MiniMax-H3显示后方,而种子2.5则使其面对相机. 该实体被放入盒子中,但其前后行方向没有得到可靠的控制. 图8.5(附录8.2)中的混合代表同样省略了四肢,而粗细的3D代理则保留了四肢. 因此,编码身份、面对方向和表达同时又保持低价渲染的代理是忠实渲染的直接杠杆,基准可以像表5那样比较固定发电机下的候选代理。

Per-view control remains good (BBox IoU 0.34 0.34 – 0.52 0.52 , CamMC 0.026 0.026 – 0.173 0.173 ; Table 3 ), but identity depends on whether the input binds each description to one person. Methods that receive identity-colored boxes (LynnReal-Omni, Seedance 2.5, MiniMax-H3) or a first frame (CWM) reach 82 82 – 94 % 94\% Appearance Compliance and 81 81 – 90 % 90\% Cross-view Consistency, whereas C2R, whose grey coarse 3D proxy draws all players alike and which receives no first frame, reaches 32 % 32\% and 26 % 26\% . State Persistence ranks the methods differently from Reappearance IoU (Section 4.4 ): The two metrics capture different aspects of long-term consistency. blocks.en: T7 The benchmark reveals what existing metrics miss, but has limitations.
blocks.zh: T7 电话 该基准揭示了现有衡量标准有哪些缺失,但也有局限性。

blocks.en:
The task metrics capture what placement and perceptual metrics miss. Interaction Success and Logic-Render Alignment are largely independent of entity placement. Within a scene, the Spearman correlation between BBox IoU and Interaction Success across methods averages 0.05 0.05 in Verified-FF and 0.06 0.06 in Unverified-FF (and 0.14 0.14 and 0.12 0.12 for Logic-Render Alignment). Interaction Success and Logic-Render Alignment also differ from each other: in Figure 8.4 , LingBot 2.0 depicts all three prescribed actions (Logic-Render Alignment 1.00 1.00 ) but misses the end state of the first event (Interaction Success 0.67 0.67 ). Logic-Render Alignment responds to the prescription rather than to the video alone: when the judge receives a mismatched timeline, the per-method mean drops from 0.46 0.46 – 0.85 0.85 to 0.07 0.07 – 0.20 0.20 , and the matched timeline scores higher in 68–97% of the samples. 
Across methods, the mean CLIP-Score varies by only 4.5 4.5 – 5.6 % 5.6\% of its average and motion smoothness by 1.5 % 1.5\% – 1.6 % 1.6\% , compared with 53 53 – 79 % 79\% for BBox IoU and 38 38 – 59 % 59\% for Interaction Success and Logic-Render Alignment. In Unverified-FF, LynnReal-Omni has the lowest CLIP-Score ( 24.2 24.2 ) while leading all entity, camera and logic metrics. The multi-view setting shows the same for geometric metrics: The results reveal a clear gap between geometric agreement and participant consistency across independently generated views. Thus, a model can generate views that are geometrically coherent while failing to preserve the same participant appearance across viewpoints. Multi-view evaluation should therefore measure both geometric and identity/appearance consistency, since geometric agreement alone is not a reliable proxy for participant consistency. The benchmark also has limitations. Interaction Success, Logic-Render Alignment and the appearance metrics rely on a VLM judge that has not yet been calibrated against human annotation; camera metrics inherit the error of the pose estimator, which reaches 1.1 1.1 – 5.4 ∘ 5.4^{\circ} ( 1.1 1.1 – 2.7 ∘ 2.7^{\circ} in Verified-FF) even on the engine renders; the Unverified-FF set was curated with MiniMax-H3 outputs and all first frames are generated by MiniMax-H3, which may favor it; and the challenge-track sets are small (ten recordings or scenes each).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PROWBench , a benchmark and extensible framework that grounds the evaluation of programmable world models in replayable world states and interaction records. Synchronized visual proxies enable controlled comparisons across representations, viewpoints, and time, while Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate complement geometric and perceptual metrics by measuring whether engine-defined rules and events are visibly realized.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PROWBennch,这是一个基准和可扩展的框架,它为在可重复播放的世界状态和互动记录中评价可编程世界模型提供了依据。 同步的视觉代用可以控制地在表示、观点和时间之间进行比较,而逻辑-渲染调节和相互作用成功率通过衡量引擎定义的规则和事件是否明显实现来补充几何和感知度量。

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate the value of explicit entity-level control: proxy-conditioned models adhere to prescribed trajectories more closely than models receiving camera control alone, and can generate coherent scenes even without an RGB first-frame reference. At the same time, visual plausibility does not guarantee faithful world realization. Appearance assignment, identity binding, and facing direction remain unreliable without a visual reference; entity control and reappearance degrade over longer horizons; and geometric agreement across independently generated views does not ensure consistent participant identity or appearance.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验证明了明确实体级控制的价值:代理条件的模型比仅接受相机控制的模型更紧密地坚持规定的轨迹,即使没有RGB第一帧的参考,也可以产生连贯的场景. 同时,视觉可信度并不能保证忠实的世界实现. 外观分配、身份约束和面对的方向仍然不可靠,没有视觉参考;实体的控制和再出现在较长的地平线上退化;独立生成的观点之间的几何协议不能确保参与者的一致身份或外观。

blocks.en: These findings position programmable-world rendering as a problem of preserving executable state across entities, events, time, and viewpoints, rather than optimizing visual quality alone. PROWBench provides a reproducible foundation for measuring progress toward this goal. Reliable generative world renderers will require stronger entity–appearance binding, event-aware generation, long-horizon state memory, and joint multi-view consistency.
blocks.zh: 这些发现将可编程-世界渲染定位为在实体、事件、时间和观点之间保持可执行状态的问题,而不是仅优化视觉质量。 PROWBENCH为衡量实现这一目标的进展情况提供了一个可复制的基础。 可靠的基因世界渲染器将要求更强大的实体 — — 存在约束、事件感知生成、长距离状态记忆以及联合多视角一致性。

blocks.en: Figure 6.1 shows all 170 cases. PROWBench comprises 170 evaluation cases identified by unique episode IDs, 200 selected camera views, and 600 proxy input videos across four collections: diverse scenarios, multi-participant trajectories, event-driven state transitions, and long-horizon trajectories. Each selected view provides three synchronized representations: coarse 3D, CWM proxy, and Colored-OBB. All source proxy inputs are rendered at 30 FPS: 570 videos are five seconds long with 150 frames each, and 30 videos are 30 seconds long with 900 frames each. There are 540 videos at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 and 60 event-driven videos at 832 × 480 832\times 480 . This yields 37,500 view-specific camera-frame observations and 112,500 proxy video frames, totaling 62.5 minutes of aggregate proxy-video duration across the three representations.

blocks.en: Scene-domain labels combine 130 native annotations with 40 source-reviewed annotations. The resulting counts are city (64), indoor (38), nature (31), racing (12), underwater (10), fantasy (8), and sky (7); city includes airport aprons and industrial outdoor settings. We review interaction labels across all 170 episodes under a common task-level policy, using source descriptions, entity roles, recorded events and trajectories, and sampled proxy frames. Labels cover the authored focal task and its participants, including explicit relative group motion; incidental background co-occurrence is excluded. Weapons, handcarts and furniture count as objects; fixed architectural access counts as human–building interaction; landmark observation and revisitation count as environment exploration. Original labels and per-tag evidence are retained. This AI-assisted review yields 293 episode–tag assignments across nine non-exclusive categories. These are source-defined task labels, including description-supported weapon use in Gunfight, and do not imply independently verified physical contact or hit causality.

blocks.en: 6.2 First-Frame Construction
blocks.zh: 6.2 一级建筑

blocks.en: The Verified-FF setting (Section 4.3 ) models the case in which an agent already has access to a concept image or character design. To provide all first-frame-conditioned methods with a common appearance reference while remaining consistent with the prescribed world state, we construct one RGB first frame for each selected view from its colored-OBB proxy and scene description. Because this image becomes part of the benchmark input, it must satisfy both appearance and geometric constraints, including the recorded person count, spatial layout, subject positions, and facing directions. We evaluated several image-generation models and selected MiniMax-H3 because it showed the strongest alignment with the proxy geometry, particularly in person count and layout. The final Verified-FF set contains 40 first frames (17 realistic and 23 stylized), all of which pass the automatic verification described below. Every method that accepts a first frame receives the same RGB image.
blocks.zh: 验证的-FF设置(第4.3节)模拟了代理人已经可以访问概念图像或字符设计的情况. 为了在与规定的世界状态保持一致的同时为所有第一帧条件的方法提供共同的外观参考,我们从其有色-OBB代理和场景描述中为每一个选定的视图构建出一个RGB第一帧. 由于这个图像成为了基准输入的一部分,它必须同时满足外观和几何限制,包括被记录的人数,空间布局,主题位置,并面对方向. 我们评价了几个图像生成模型,并选择了MiniMax-H3,因为它显示了与代理几何最强的相通,特别是在人数和布局上. 最终的验证-FF集包含40个第一帧(17个现实版和23个阶地版),全部通过下文所描述的自动验证. 每一个接受第一帧的方法都得到相同的RGB图像.

blocks.en: Generation. Before generation, the appearance of every entity is fixed in text: each person, vehicle, and animal is assigned a concrete appearance from a reference library matched to the scene and target style, preventing the generator from implicitly choosing identities or appearances. The generation prompt combines three components: (i) a frame-0 layout contract specifying the screen position, extent, and facing direction of every visible entity according to the engine record; (ii) the proxy-control block used by the text prompts (Appendix 6.3 ), which binds geometry to the proxy and appearance to text; and (iii) the scene appearance and style description. MiniMax-H3 receives the first 22 frames of the colored-OBB proxy together with this prompt, without an RGB image reference, and generates a short video. We use frame 0 of the generated clip, at 1280 × 720 1280{\times}720 , as the candidate first frame. For each view-specific instance, we generate three candidates using different random seeds.

MiniMax-H3与这个快讯一起接收了彩色-OBB代理的前22帧,没有RGB图像参考,并生成了短视频. 我们使用生成剪辑的0帧,在1280×720 1280\times}720,作为候选第一帧. 对于每个特定景点,我们用不同的随机种子产生出三个候选人.

blocks.en: 6.3 Text Prompts
blocks.zh: 6.3 文本提示

blocks.en: Each method receives a text prompt for every rendered view of a scene. The underlying engine provides structured metadata for each view, including scene attributes, entity annotations, temporal events, and view-dependent observations. We first construct a unified base prompt from this metadata. Except for the appearance description, all prompt content is generated deterministically from the engine records; the appearance block is the only component produced by a vision–language model. The base prompt is then converted, again deterministically, into the input format required by each method. As a result, prompt construction is reproducible for a fixed set of engine records, and differences across methods arise from their input interfaces and proxy representations. We describe below the source fields, base-prompt construction, the system prompt, representation-specific wording, and the differences between the two main-track settings and across methods. Prompts C.1 and C.2 at the end of this section show the base prompt and a converted prompt for one view.
blocks.zh: 每种方法都收到一个文本提示,以显示一个场景的每个视图。 基础引擎为每个视图提供结构化的元数据,包括场景属性,实体说明,时间事件,以及视线依赖的观测. 我们首先从这个元数据中构建一个统一的基点提示. 除了外观描述外,所有即时内容都是从引擎记录中决定性地生成的;外观块是视觉-语言模型产生的唯一组件. 然后,将基准提示转换成每种方法所需的输入格式。 因此,对于一组固定的引擎记录,可以再现出即时的构造,而不同方法之间的分歧也源于其输入界面和代理表示. 下面我们叙述源字段、基点-即时构造、系统即时性、具体表述的措词以及两种主轨设置和各种方法之间的差异。 本节末尾的提示 C.1 和 C.2 显示一个视图的基数和转换后提示 。

blocks.en: Source Fields. For each rendered view, the base prompt is constructed from the following records: • Scene description : an authored textual description consisting of a target rendering-style line, an environment paragraph, and a protagonist paragraph. The style line is copied verbatim into every prompt. When no first frame is provided, the environment and protagonist descriptions also serve as the source of appearance information. • Entity annotations : all dynamic entities and interaction objects, together with their engine identifiers, semantic classes, and role descriptions (e.g., “the receiving companion”). For each entity, we record whether it is visible at frame 0, based on the engine visibility flags and its projected bounding box. If an entity enters the view later, its first entry time is also recorded. In the colored-OBB representation, each entity is additionally assigned a unique identity color. • Action timeline : phase boundaries are recomputed from the recorded frames, while retaining the engine-authored sentence associated with each phase. We augment these descriptions with measured facts derived from the recorded trajectories, including the path length of each moving entity (e.g., “moves about 10 metres along its route”), inter-entity relations, final resting locations of moving objects, and occlusion events. These descriptions do not use camera-relative direction terms. • Appearance source : in Verified-FF, appearance is derived from the verified first frame; in Unverified-FF, it is taken from the authored scene description. Camera motion is deliberately excluded from the text prompt and is provided only through the method’s control input, i.e., the proxy video or camera trajectory.

blocks.en: Base-Prompt Construction. Except for the appearance block, the base prompt is generated entirely by a deterministic script, so identical engine records yield identical text. The prompt contains five components. (1) A fixed control block specifies the roles of the two references: the proxy video provides the exact position, extent, orientation, and timing of every subject, but never its target appearance; the RGB first frame, when available, determines subject identity, appearance, and rendering style, but does not prescribe subsequent motion. The control block also defines the precedence of information sources in case of disagreement: geometry, camera, and motion follow the proxy; style and appearance follow the first frame; articulated actions follow the timestamped text. (2) Subject definitions assign each subject a unique name and explicitly bind it to its proxy representation. (3) A one-sentence task summary states the generation objective and shot duration. (4) A retention analysis specifies, for each subject, which properties must be preserved from each reference. (5) A detailed description specifies the rendering style, environment, appearance of every subject, and a contiguous action timeline covering the full five-second clip. The timeline is expressed as consecutive intervals from 00:00.000 to 00:05.000, for example: “From 00:00.000 to 00:04.667, the protagonist walks across the road while the approaching vehicles brake and yield; the protagonist moves about 10 metres along its route; …”.
blocks.zh: 基地-Prompt建设. 除外出块外,基点快取完全由定型脚本所生成,因此相同的引擎记录产生出相同的文本. 提示包含五个组件. (1)一个固定的控制块指定了两个参考物的作用:代理视频提供了每个主体的确切位置,范围,取向,以及时间,但绝不是其目标外观;RGB第一帧,在可用时,确定主体身份,外观,和渲染风格,但没有规定后续运动. 控制块还定义了在出现分歧时信息来源的优先权:几何,相机,和运动跟随代理;风格和外观跟随第一帧;被阐明的动作跟随时间标注的文本. (2)主题定义指定了每个主题的独特名称,并明确约束它与其代理代表. (3) 一判决任务摘要说明生成目标和拍摄时间。 (4) 留存额分析为每个主体具体规定了必须从每一参考物中保留哪些属性。 (5)一个详细的描述规定了每个题材的渲染风格,环境,外观,以及覆盖了完整五秒片段的相接动作时间表. 时间表以从00:00.000到00:05.000的相接间隔表示,例如:“从00:00.000到00:04.667, 主角走过道路,而接近的车辆刹车和起落;主角沿行走约10米;......”。

blocks.en: The appearance block is produced by Qwen3.6-27B [ 41 ] with greedy decoding. Its input consists of two images: the RGB first frame and frame 0 of the CWM proxy render. The latter is used solely as a layout reference for matching people and objects in the first frame to engine entities; it is not treated as an appearance reference. The model outputs a concise description of the opening frame and environment, the appearance and initial pose of each entity, and any discrepancy between the first frame and the recorded layout. To prevent the proxy representation from being mistaken for target appearance, proxy-specific terms such as mannequin, wireframe, and bounding box are disallowed.
blocks.zh: 外观块由Qwen3.6-27B[41]用贪婪的解码来出产. 它的输入由两个图像组成:CWM代理渲染的RGB第一个帧和帧0. 后者仅用作将第一帧中的人物和对象与引擎实体相匹配的布局参考;它不被视为外观参考. 该模型对初始框架和环境、每个实体的外观和初始姿势,以及第一个框架与记录的布局之间的任何差异,作了简明的说明。 为防止代理代理代表被误认为目标外观,不允许使用人造人,线框等特定代理名词.

blocks.en: Every composed prompt is checked by an automatic validator. The validator requires that (i) every subject is defined, preserved, and described; (ii) only the allowed references are mentioned; (iii) the timeline is contiguous and covers exactly 0–5 s; (iv) prompts without a first frame contain no first-frame references; and (v) the required representation-specific wording is present. If validation fails, the validation errors are returned to the VLM for one regeneration attempt.
blocks.zh: 由自动验证器检查每个自动提示。 验证人要求:(一) 每一个主题都得到界定、保存和描述;(二) 只提及允许的参考文献;(三) 时间线是相接的,范围完全为0至5 s; (四) 没有第一个框架的提示没有第一框架的参考文献; (五) 有所要求的针对代表的具体措辞。 如果验证失败, 验证错误将返回到 VLM 中进行一次再生尝试 。

blocks.en:
System Prompt. The control block plays the role of a system prompt, but how it reaches each model depends on the model’s text interface. CWM is the only method whose interface has a separate system role. Its text encoder applies the Qwen chat template with two turns, a fixed system prompt followed by a user turn containing the <Picture 1> and <Video 1> references and the caption, and encodes the formatted sequence in a single pass.
The release ships two such system prompts, one for the first generation window and one for continuation windows. Our control block is adapted from this system prompt, with three changes for the box proxy: the proxy gives each subject’s exact extent and must be followed precisely (CWM’s prompt treats its proxy as a coarse reference), the white face of a box marks the entity’s front, and the hexadecimal colour tags are identity codes. MiniMax-H3 and LynnReal-Omni use no chat template and no system role: their text encoder receives one token sequence consisting of a label and the visual tokens of each reference (<Picture 1> for the first frame, <Video 1> for the proxy video), followed by the prompt verbatim, so the control block enters as the first part of the prompt (Prompt C.1). The Seedance 2.5 API likewise accepts a single prompt. In Unverified-FF, Seedance 2.5 receives the base prompt with the control block at its start, as MiniMax-H3 does. In Verified-FF, it receives a deterministic conversion of the same base prompt into its reference syntax, as C2R and CWM receive conversions into theirs: the conversion keeps the style line, the appearance of every subject, the binding of each subject to its box by colour name and legend colour, the proxy semantics, and the timestamped timeline, but states the proxy semantics as ordinary sentences instead of a control block (Table 6.3 ). C2R, Cosmos-Transfer2.5, and the camera-conditioned world models receive no system prompt, and their converted prompts contain no proxy terminology (Prompt C.2).
blocks.zh:
系统提示。 控制块发挥系统即时的作用,但如何到达每个模型取决于模型的文本界面. CWM是其接口具有单独系统作用的唯一方法. 它的文本编码器应用了带有两个转折的Quen聊天模板,一个固定的系统后接一个包含"Picture 1"和"Video 1"引用和标题的用户转折,并将格式化的序列以单通编码.
释放船有两个这样的系统提示,一个用于第一代窗口,一个用于续作窗口. 我们的控制块是从这个系统即时改编而来,对盒子代理有三处变化:代理给出了每个主体的确切范围,必须精确遵循(CWM的即时将它的代理作为粗略的参考),盒子的白色面额标记了实体的正面,而十六进制的颜色标记是身份代码. MiniMax-H3和LynnReal-Omni没有使用聊天模板,也没有系统角色:他们的文本编码器收到由标签和每个参考物的可视符号组成的一个符号序列(第一帧为<Picture 1>,代理视频为<Video 1>),之后是即时逐字记录,因此控制块作为快取的第一部分(Prompt C.1)进入. 种子2.5 API同样接受单一的提示. 在Unveryd-FF中,"种子2.5"在初始时与控制块一起接收基点快取,就像"MiniMax-H3"一样. 在"验证-FF"中,它得到一个确定性转换,将同个碱基即时被转换成它的参考语法,因为C2R和CWM接收到转换为他们的:转换保留了样式行,每个主体的外观,每个主体按颜色名称和传说颜色与其盒子绑定,代理语义,以及时间标定的时间表,但将代理语义作为普通句子来表示而不是一个控制块(表6.3). C2R, Cosmos-Transfer2.5,相机条件的世界模型没有获得系统快取,其转换的快取没有代理名词(Prompt C.2).

blocks.en: Representation-Specific Wording. Only two parts of the base prompt depend on the proxy representation: the sentence defining the semantics of the proxy video, and the rule used to bind each subject to its proxy. • Coarse 3D proxy: the full scene is represented as an untextured light-grey low-poly proxy. People are articulated grey block figures whose recorded limb motion must be preserved. All grey surfaces encode geometry only and must not be interpreted as target colors or materials. • CWM proxy : people are represented as flat blue upright mannequins with a fixed pose; they translate and rotate but carry no limb-motion information. Interaction objects are shown as red boxes. The environment is rendered using flat semantic colors that act only as proxy codes and do not correspond to target materials or colors. • Colored-OBB: people, vehicles, animals, and interaction objects are represented as semi-transparent solid boxes, with one unique identity color per entity. The color serves only to identify which box corresponds to which subject and must not be interpreted as a target color or material. The white face marks the front of the entity; hence, if the white face is not visible, the entity is facing away from the camera. The white face itself is likewise only a proxy marker and must not appear in the generated result.
blocks.zh: 代表性-特写词. 碱性即时只有两部分依赖于代理代表:定义代理视频语义的句子,以及用来将每个被主体与其代理绑定的规则. •粗口3D代用:全场代表为无文字光灰低孔代用. 人们被描绘成灰色的块状人物 记录下来的四肢运动必须保存 所有灰色表面只编码几何,不得被解释为目标颜色或材料. • CWM代理:人被代表为平地蓝色直立外形有固定姿势的活人;他们翻译并旋转,但携带不带肢体运动信息. 交互对象显示为红框. 环境使用平面语义颜色来渲染,这些颜色只是作为代用代码,与目标材料或颜色不符. • 有色-OBB:人、车辆、动物和相互作用物体作为半透明的固体盒来代表,每个实体有一个独特的身份颜色。 颜色仅用于识别哪个盒子对应哪个对象,不得被解释为目标颜色或材料. 白色相貌标志了实体的正面;因此,如果白色相貌不明显,则实体正向远离相机. 白相本身同样只是代用标记,不得出现在所生成的结果中.

blocks.en: For colored-OBBs, each subject definition explicitly identifies its proxy using the hexadecimal legend color. For example: “<Subject 3> is the passenger car: in <Picture 1> a classic red sedan with a white license plate, parked on the right side of the street facing away from the camera; in <Video 1> the object proxy tagged #f79e36, whose white face is its front.” Subjects that are not visible at frame 0 are additionally annotated with their first entry time. In the main track, the methods that receive the box proxy (MiniMax-H3, LynnReal-Omni and Seedance 2.5) use the colored-OBB prompt; C2R, which receives the coarse 3D proxy, and CWM, which receives the CWM proxy, use converted prompts without proxy wording (Table 6.3 ). The coarse 3D and CWM proxy base prompts are used for MiniMax-H3 only in the representation study (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 对于有色-OBBs,每个主题定义都使用十六进制的传说颜色明确识别出它的代理. 例如: " subject 3 " 是客车:在 " Picture 1 " 中,一辆带有白色牌照的经典红色轿车,停在离相机不远的街上右侧;在 " Video 1 " 中,物体代理标记为#f79e36,其白色脸是它的正面 " 。 框架0中看不到的主题会附加说明,并附上其首次进入的时间。 在主音轨中,接收盒代理的方法(MiniMax-H3,LynnReal-Omni和Speedance 2.5)使用有色-OBB提示;接收粗3D代理的C2R和接收CWM代理的CWM使用转换的提示而无需代理用词(表6.3). 粗细的3D和CWM代理基提示仅在表示研究中使用了MiniMax-H3(表5.).

blocks.en: Verified-FF versus Unverified-FF. Table 6.2 summarizes the two main-track settings. They share the same structural skeleton, including subject definitions, proxy bindings, the action timeline, and all measured facts. They differ only in the source of appearance information and in the role of the first frame.
blocks.zh: 表6.2概述了两种主轨设置。 它们具有相同的结构骨架,包括主题定义,代理约束,行动时间表,以及所有测量的事实. 它们仅在外观信息的来源和第一帧的作用上有所不同.

blocks.en: Prompt Formats across Methods. The base prompt is designed for models that can consume explicitly tagged image and video references. For methods with different interfaces, we apply deterministic transformations that modify the format while preserving the underlying semantic content to the extent permitted by the target interface (Table 6.3 ). No transformation relies on a language model. In Unverified-FF, the appearance description used by CWM is derived from frame 0 of the MiniMax-H3 output, which also serves as CWM’s RGB anchor frame.
blocks.zh: 跨方法的快速格式。 基础快取被设计为能够消耗有明确标记的图像和视频引用的模型. 对于具有不同接口的方法,我们采用定型转换,在目标接口允许的范围内修改格式,同时保留基本的语义内容(表6.3)。 没有转换依赖于语言模型. 在Unveryd-FF中,CWM使用的外观描述取自于MiniMax-H3输出的帧0,它也作为CWM的RGB主锚框架.

Two visual references accompany this text. <Video 1> is the conditioning proxy video: treat it as the exact spatiotemporal reference for where every subject is, how large it is and how it moves, but never as an appearance template or literal target geometry. <Picture 1> is the global RGB anchor image: it defines identity and appearance, never motion. <Picture 1> is the ABSOLUTE standard for the worldview, art direction and overall style of the entire take, and on worldview, art direction and style it outranks even the description below. It provides NOTHING about any later frame’s camera, composition, motion or interactions. Each subject’s position and motion come from <Video 1>. A subject’s appearance follows <Picture 1> when that subject is visible in it; subjects not visible in <Picture 1> take their appearance from the text, rendered consistently in <Picture 1>’s worldview and art direction. in <Video 1> the human proxy tagged #366ef7, whose white face is its front. <Subject 3> is the passenger car: in <Picture 1> A classic red sedan with a white license plate, parked on the right side of the street facing away from the camera; in <Video 1> the object proxy tagged #f79e36, whose white face is its front. <Subject 4> is the passenger car: in <Picture 1> A classic black sedan with chrome bumpers and round headlights, parked on the left side of the street facing the camera; in <Video 1> the object proxy tagged #6636f7, whose white face is its front. <Subject 5> is independently moving adult participant 1: in <Picture 1> A young man with dark hair, wearing a mustard hooded jacket, dark shorts, and white sneakers, standing on the left sidewalk facing the street; Use <Video 1> for layout, root motion, object trajectories, action timing and the camera path, and keep the appearance, materials and lighting established in <Picture 1>. retention_analysis: <Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the first frame of the target video reproduces this image exactly, including every person’s appearance, the objects, the scene layout, materials, lighting and framing; later frames evolve continuously from it. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - retain the proxy’s framewise root position, occupied scale, root orientation (the white face of the box is the front of the body), identity continuity and interaction timing from <Video 1>; reconstruct its appearance from <Picture 1> and its articulated motion from the timeline below. blocks.en: Prompt C.2  Converted prompt for C2R, Cosmos-Transfer2.5 and the camera-conditioned world models A high-quality video of a person crossing a road as approaching vehicles brake and yield. Anime-style rendering: a 2D anime look with hand-drawn character design and painted backgrounds over the full 3D world — modern digital anime: gradient shading, glossy highlights, clean thin contour lines, vivid high-contrast colours; no proxy colours, wireframes, block figures or game UI; the opening frame establishes this look and every later frame keeps it. The setting is a wide urban street paved with asphalt and marked with white lane lines, flanked by sidewalks with moss-toned metal railings. There are 4 persons in this video. The protagonist is a man with short brown hair, wearing a dark charcoal suit and black shoes, walking away from the camera down the center of the road. The passenger car 1 is a classic red sedan with a white license plate, parked on the right side of the street facing away from the camera. The passenger car 2 is a classic black sedan with chrome bumpers and round headlights, parked on the left side of the street facing the camera. Independently moving adult participant 1 is a young man with dark hair, wearing a mustard hooded jacket, dark shorts, and white sneakers, standing on the left sidewalk facing the street. Independently moving adult participant 2 is a person with short blonde hair, wearing a maroon hoodie and blue jeans, standing on the right sidewalk facing the street. Independently moving adult participant 3 is a man with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt under dark blue overalls and brown shoes, standing on the left sidewalk near the black car. Over the five seconds, the protagonist walks across the road while the approaching vehicles brake and yield, and then the protagonist reaches the far side of the road and keeps walking. Human motion is natural and continuous, presented in a cinematic style with sharp details, clean textures, and no blur or visual artifacts.

We evaluate entities marked as dynamic or interaction candidates, excluding terrain, effects, and scene geometry. Entities that are not visible in the reference view are excluded from evaluation, with additional filtering for first-person views to remove the camera wearer and other entities that dominate the field of view.
Generated entities are localized using SAM 3 [ 7 ] from text prompts derived from their semantic labels.
Generated tracks are matched to reference entities by label-compatible Hungarian matching using track-level mean IoU.

blocks.en: Imaging Quality (MUSIQ [ 21 ] ) and Aesthetic Quality (the LAION aesthetic predictor) follow VBench [ 19 ] . Warp Error [ 23 , 33 ] estimates RAFT optical flow between consecutive frames at 672 × 384 672\times 384 , warps the next frame back to the current one, masks occlusions by forward–backward consistency and reports the masked mean squared RGB error ( × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} ). Motion Smoothness is the VBench score that reconstructs frames with a video frame-interpolation model [ 28 ] . CLIP-Score [ 42 ] is the mean cosine similarity ( × 100 \times 100 ) between CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings of the 40 grid frames and the episode’s action title. These metrics are computed without reference to the engine state and therefore measure plausibility, not adherence.

blocks.en: For each intended participant in the multi-view setting, Appearance Compliance ( Comp. ) asks whether the person at the engine-projected location matches the authored appearance description shared by all methods, judged per view at 0.5, 2.5, and 4.5 s from the full frame and a target crop. Cross-view Appearance Consistency ( Cons. ) asks whether the participant looks the same across views: the judge compares every pair of synchronized views without the description, ignoring changes in pose, viewpoint, lighting, and front/back visibility. A participant can thus be consistent yet non-compliant. Both metrics use Qwen3.6-27B with greedy decoding on five attributes (clothing color, clothing style, hair, accessories, and build) and skip attributes that are undescribed or not visible. An observation o o (person–view–time for Comp., person–view-pair–time for Cons.) with judgeable attributes 𝒜 o \mathcal{A}_{o} scores q o = ∏ a ∈ 𝒜 o 𝟏 ​ [ attribute ​ a ​ matches or agrees ] , q_{o}=\prod_{a\in\mathcal{A}_{o}}\mathbf{1}[\text{attribute }a\text{ matches or agrees}], (7) i.e., every judged attribute must pass. Observations with an absent target or no judgeable attribute are unscored. Scores are averaged over views or view pairs, then over participant–time groups, then equally over scenes, and reported in percent; because unscored observations are excluded, both metrics should be read together with the BBox miss rate.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个有意参与多视图设定的参与者,外观合规(Comp.)询问,在引擎所预测位置的人是否与所有方法共享的作者外观描述相匹配,按照0.5,2.5和4.5s的视角从全帧和目标作物判断. 交叉视角相容性(Cons.)询问参与者对不同视角的相貌是否相同:法官比较每对同步视角而不描述,忽略了姿势,视角,照明,和前/后能见度的变化. 因此,参与者可以是一致的,但却不符合要求。 两种度量衡都使用Qwen3.6-27B,在五个属性上(服装颜色,服装样式,发型,饰品,和构造)有贪婪的解码,并跳过未描述或不可见的属性. 有可判断属性 A o\ mathcal{A}_{o} 得分 q o = Q 个 A o 1 [属性匹配或同意] 的观察 o (人- 视图- 时为comp. person- view- pair- time for Cons.), q_{o\ prod\ a\\ in mathcal{A}_{o}}\mathbf{ 1} [\text{atpition} a\text{匹配或同意} , (7) 即每个判断属性都必须通过 。 没有目标或没有可判断的属性的意见没有记分。 分数在视图或取景对数中平均,然后在参与者-时间组数中平均,然后在场景中平均,并以百分比报告;由于没有分数的观测结果被排除在外,两个衡量标准应该与BBox误差率一起阅读。

blocks.en: We also report MEt3R [ 2 ] , which compares image features after aligning views through geometry predicted from the generated frames. It measures mutual consistency of the generated views, not agreement with the engine geometry, and complements the person-level appearance judgments rather than measuring adherence to an appearance description. We evaluate all six pairs of the four views at nine synchronized times per scene, average both comparison directions, and average scenes equally; lower is better.
blocks.zh: 我们还报告 Met3R [2],它通过从生成的框架预测的几何来对图像特性进行比对。 它衡量所产生观点的相互一致性,而不是与引擎几何一致,并且补充了人级外观判断,而不是衡量对外观描述的遵守程度. 我们按每个场景同步9次,平均两个比较方向,平均场景均匀地评价所有6对4个景点;更低则更好.

Table 8.1 summarizes the conditioning inputs, spatial resolutions, frame rates, and delivered frame counts of the evaluated methods. blocks.en: Without a verified first frame, models still render the described world in alignment with the proxy. Current models do not need an appearance reference to render a coherent scene. From the proxy and the text alone, most of them synthesize the scene in the prescribed style and keep it aligned with the proxy: in Figure 8.9 , LynnReal-Omni, Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax-H3 reproduce the requested marker-sketch style with varying fidelity, CWM inherits it from MiniMax-H3’s frame 0, and C2R renders the scene photorealistically although its prompt requests the same style, while in every method the protagonist climbs toward the upper landing at the prescribed times (pair IoU 0.52 0.52 – 0.61 0.61 ). What the first frame would otherwise fix, however, is left to the model: which way each entity faces and which described appearance belongs to which person.
blocks.zh: 没有经过核实的第一帧,模型仍然使所描述的世界与被代理人一致. 目前的模型不需要外观参考来制作一个连贯的场景. 仅取自代理和文本,大部分都以规定的样式合成了场景并保持与代理对齐: 在图中 8.9, LynnReal-Omni, Seedance 2.5和MiniMax-H3以不同的忠心复制了所请求的标记-sketch样式,CWM从MiniMax-H3的帧0继承了它,C2R使场景的相片现实化了,尽管它的即时要求具有相同的风格,而在每一种方法中,主角都以规定的时间(pair IoU 0.52 0.52 – 0.61 0.61)爬向上着陆. 然而,第一个框架本来可以解决什么问题,留给模型来决定:每个实体面对什么方式,描述的外观属于哪个人。
